facts.fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa says Chad's government, through the Ministry of Telecommunications, Digital Economy and Digitalization of Administration with ECA and GIZ, is developing a National Data Governance Strategy, with consultations on 13-15 May 2026 and a stakeholder workshop on 21 May 2026 to validate findings; the page announces these engagements and carries no publication date (its published date is a proxy for their start).

systems.country_label: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données
systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications, Digital Economy and Digitalization of Administration, with ECA and GIZ

note: No fact on use: the ministry leads drafting, but no body is named to carry out an adopted policy and no rules are issued.
